dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, high-contrast white perimeters with irregular, jagged geometry transitioning into darker grey interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily located in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most distinct macro-annuli on the anterior-dorsal surface form an irregular polygonal spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, high-intensity white linear boundary is visible at the neck transition, creating a distinct visual demarcation between the head and the patterned body.
